question: How does the world revolve under the Lord's oversight?
premises: Nature produces moving and still things under the Lord's oversight.
By this cause the world revolves.
The Lord has no action-bondage because of indifference.
inference: The Lord is cause of world-creation without relying on activity.
uncertainties: Fused compounds are read as single units.
plain_english: With me as overseer, nature produces moving and still things; by this cause, son of Kunti, the world revolves. There is no action-bondage for me by indifference, because I exist; therefore I am cause in world-creation without relying on activity.
